article.title: Part to apply only to certain High Courts.
article.content:
116Part to apply only to certain High Courts.

Section 116
This Part applies only to High Courts 2[not being the court of a Judicial Commissioner.]

Subs. by Act 2 of 1951, s. 14, for “CHARTERED HIGH COURTS” (w.e.f. 1-4-1951).
2 Subs. by the Adaptation of Laws (No. 2) Order, 1956 for “For Part A States and Part B States”.
